reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal modifies Marinade's fee structure by removing a fixed 9.5% performance fee and replacing it with a conditional fee triggered when Marinade APY exceeds the Solana Staking Rate (SSR). Also adds a uniform 20 basis point unstake fee across all products. No appendices included.
reasoning_trace.inference: This is a parameter change affecting revenue collection mechanisms. Need to verify if fee amounts are fully specified and who controls implementation.

reasoning_trace.observation: Author is helloiamvu. Proposal affects Marinade stakers (who pay fees) and the DAO treasury (which receives fee revenue). No external counterparties named.
reasoning_trace.inference: Three stakeholders: proposer and two affected groups. No grants, external contracts, or third-party beneficiaries.

reasoning_trace.observation: Proposal specifies removing 9.5% performance fee and adding 20 bps (0.20%) unstake fee. The conditional performance fee percentage when triggered is never specified.
reasoning_trace.inference: Treasury impact direction is unknown - removes one fee, adds two others (one with unspecified rate). Net effect depends on performance, unstake volume, and the missing conditional fee percentage.

reasoning_trace.observation: The conditional performance fee percentage is never stated. Proposal says fee applies 'only when Marinade outperforms' but doesn't define the rate charged when this condition is met.
reasoning_trace.inference: Critical parameter missing. Cannot assess treasury impact or user cost without knowing the conditional fee percentage. This is a high-severity vague_kpi issue - delegates are voting on an undefined fee.

reasoning_trace.observation: No specification of who calculates SSR, determines when conditional fees trigger, sets the conditional fee percentage, or has authority to adjust parameters post-approval.
reasoning_trace.inference: Implementation authority is undefined. This creates potential for unilateral parameter control after governance approval. High-severity backdoor_permission flag - new authority with unspecified scope.

reasoning_trace.observation: SSR defined conceptually as 'network-wide staking rewards derived from inflation and transaction fees' but calculation methodology, data sources, oracle specifications, and verification mechanisms are absent.
reasoning_trace.inference: Critical technical implementation details missing. Different calculation methods could materially change when fees trigger and by how much. Medium-severity technical_risk.

summary: Marinade fee revamp removes fixed 9.5% performance fee, adds conditional fee when outperforming chain-wide staking rate, and imposes 20 bps unstake fee. Conditional fee percentage unspecified; calculation authority undefined.

stakeholders.name: Marinade stakers
stakeholders.citation: stakers increasingly prioritize APY and select providers offering optimal net returns

stakeholders.name: Marinade DAO treasury
stakeholders.citation: aligning DAO revenue with demonstrated outperformance

treasury_impact.citation: removes the current 9.5% performance fee from Marinade Native and mSOL rewards [...] conditional fee that is charged only when Marinade outperforms the Solana Staking Rate [...] 20 basis points (0.20%) unstake fee - conditional fee percentage not specified, making net impact incalculable

red_flags.detail: Conditional performance fee percentage is never specified. Proposal authorizes charging fees when outperforming SSR but doesn't define the rate, making treasury impact and user cost impossible to evaluate.
red_flags.citation: conditional fee that is charged only when Marinade outperforms the Solana Staking Rate [...] New performance fee applies only when Marinade APY exceeds the Solana Staking Rate

red_flags.detail: No specification of who has authority to calculate SSR, determine when conditional fees trigger, set the conditional fee percentage, or adjust parameters post-approval. New authority granted with undefined scope.
red_flags.citation: Solana Staking Rate (SSR) Definition: SSR represents network-wide staking rewards derived from inflation and transaction fees (including priority fees)

red_flags.detail: SSR calculation methodology not specified. No oracle, data source, verification mechanism, or dispute resolution process defined. Different calculation approaches could materially change when fees trigger and revenue outcomes.
red_flags.citation: network-wide staking rewards derived from inflation and transaction fees (including priority fees). MEV is explicitly excluded

red_flags.detail: No implementation timeline, test period, or review checkpoint specified. No staged rollout or validation phase before full deployment across all Marinade products.
red_flags.citation: Vote went live on Realms December 22, 2025

questions_to_ask: What is the percentage rate for the conditional performance fee when Marinade APY exceeds SSR?
Who has the authority to calculate SSR, determine when fees trigger, and set or adjust the conditional fee percentage?
What specific data sources, oracles, and calculation methodology will be used to compute SSR and Marinade APY for comparison?
Is there a cap on the conditional performance fee, or can the rate be changed without further governance approval?
What is the projected annual DAO revenue under this structure compared to the current 9.5% fixed fee, under various performance scenarios?
Will there be a test period, audit, or gradual rollout before full implementation across Marinade Native, mSOL, and Marinade Select?
